caution_findings.evidence_context: The methods/results prose identify MR S. aureus ATCC 33591 for biofilm testing, while Table 4 caption states ATCC 33951. Table 4 row targets preserve the caption, and MBEC prose rows preserve the prose target.

DBAASP/DRAMP provide exact hemolysis and HEK293 curve values; primary text gives thresholds and IC50, while Figure 2/3 are plotted images rather than numeric source tables. Exact figure-digitized values remain database cautions, not source_verified table values.

DRAMP aggregate rows repeat source-supported sequence/MIC claims but omit some Table 3 targets and include exact figure-derived toxicity values; CAMP reverses the hemolysis threshold sign. These rows are preserved as source_conflict with locators.

The OA package contains article XML/PDF/figures and the landed supplementary directory contains HTML/page-image assets, not a separate XLSX/PDF data supplement that changes activity or database adjudication.
Mechanism statements are limited to physicochemical inference, antibiofilm phenotype, and author hypothesis; exact molecular mechanisms of B1 and combinations were not directly assayed.
